_comment: Reference example only. Prefer `aps install`, which writes these hooks into
~/.bob/settings/settings.json with absolute paths for your machine, makes a
backup first, and keeps your other settings.
Manual setup: replace <PYTHON> with the full path of your Python interpreter
(not 'python3', which can open the Microsoft Store on Windows; a hook that
fails to start does NOT block the tool call) and <REPO> with this repository's path.
escalation_timeout (120 s) < HOOK_DEADLINE_SECONDS (130 s) < PreToolUse timeout here (150 s)
